mapper.sql: p.org_id=#{org} AND p.data_mode=#{mode} AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_access_grant g WHERE g.org_id=p.org_id AND g.patient_id=p.id AND g.subject_id=#{subject} AND g.capability='PATIENT_READ' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.valid_from <= #{now} AND (g.valid_until IS NULL OR g.valid_until > #{now})) AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') ESCAPE '='
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM patient WHERE id=#{id} AND org_id=#{org} AND data_mode=#{mode} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient p WHERE
SELECT p.* FROM patient p WHERE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
